subject.title: fix(agents): cloud thinking models time out at 120s during reasoning (#80349) [AI-assisted]

question: Should this PR require a completed live Gemini embedded-run proof before merge, or can maintainers accept source-level resolver proof plus the HTTP 429 endpoint reach for this timeout-default change?
rationale: The code change alters an implicit availability guard for existing cloud thinking runs, and only maintainers can decide whether source-level proof is enough when live Google quota is unavailable.

options.title: Require live Gemini proof
options.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a short recording showing a non-off Gemini thinking turn completes without the ~125s timeout after the rebased patch.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the resolver and fake-timer proof plus the documented tradeoff, then review the rebased conflict resolution carefully.

options.title: Pause behind canonical bug
options.body: Leave this PR open but blocked until someone with suitable Google quota can reproduce and prove the full after-fix user path.

recommendation.title: Require live Gemini proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a short recording showing a non-off Gemini thinking turn completes without the ~125s timeout after the rebased patch.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history on this timeout policy and merged the current-main change that the branch now conflicts with.
